name: Carmilla
source:
"My love, we are not here to give blood. We're here to take it."

Carmilla is flirty, carefree, and incredibly cool.  She thinks humans are cute and can be a bit naïve.

[From [url=https://scribbles.itch.io/night-of-the-lesbian-vampires]itch.io[/url]]
